```
['validate the Databricks Responses API environment with headers, model name, and LiteLLM parameters', 'build the complete Databricks Responses API endpoint URL from an api_base and LiteLLM parameters', 'transform a Databricks Responses API request by stripping the databricks/ prefix and delegating to OpenAI transformation', 'test whether Databricks Responses API supports native WebSocket streaming', 'review the DatabricksResponsesAPIConfig class and its custom_llm_provider property returning DATABRICKS']

```
